newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Quinn says 98 budget to be presented before Nov 98.
newsitem.headline: Quinn says 98 budget to be presented before Nov 98.

text.p: Irish Finance Minister Ruairi Quinn on Wednesday said that the budget for 1998 will be prepared and presented to parliament well before the end of November 1997.
This in turn will advance the timing of the annual Estimates campaign, Quinn said in his budget speech.
"This will improve the efficiency of our budgetary practices," Quinn told the Irish parliament in his budget speech.
"It will also enable subsidiary organisations to be informed of their exact budgetary allocation before the start of the calendar year."

Under the present regime, such organisations could be three months into the year before they knew their total allocations for the year, he said. "That is why it is now being changed." -- Dublin Newsroom +3531 661 3377
